scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence for Episode 6 of Behind the Scenes.

scenes.title: Luo Lin's Tangled Excuses
scenes.summary: Brief recap and coda of Xin Huimei pressing Luo Lin on who betrayed Chun Yuqiao first during their past breakup.

scenes.title: Apple Juice for the Boss
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao surprises Xiaoye and a crew member in the office by asking for something flavoured to drink instead of plain warm water and heading to the pantry for apple juice.

scenes.title: Knowing Every Show by Heart
scenes.summary: In the administration pantry, Xiaoye tells Chun Yuqiao how Bu Xiaogu studied every detail of his programmes before joining Xingtian and belongs in production rather than admin.

scenes.title: A Younger Version of Chun Yuqiao
scenes.summary: When Chun Yuqiao asks whether Bu Xiaogu should look for a boyfriend, Xiaoye describes the ideal match as a younger, rising-star version of him and pours him coffee.

scenes.title: Executive Pressure Over Studio Four
scenes.summary: The chairwoman's brother and rival unit heads corner Chun Yuqiao in the lounge and demand that he hand back Studio Four and stay inside Unit One.

scenes.title: Sent Back to Administration
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu eagerly brings Chun Yuqiao a notebook of production questions, and though he praises her insights, he abruptly sends her back to administration when the human-resources director arrives.

scenes.title: Nothing Left to Fix in Admin
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao orders his Studio Four supervisor not to hand over control, while back in administration Bu Xiaogu has already finished every chore and begs to help overworked Unit One.

scenes.title: Backroom Radio Plot
scenes.summary: The two blacklisted commentators meet the vice president in secret and plan an online radio interview with entertainment reporter Bianbian to stir up gossip against Chun Yuqiao.

scenes.title: A Sword Hanging Over Unit One
scenes.summary: At the hospital, Xingzi tells newly recovered Kaiwen that Chun Yuqiao sent Bu Xiaogu away; they vow to watch Bianbian and the commentators, then panic when Xin Huimei asks to meet their boss.

scenes.title: Turning the Radio Interview Around
scenes.summary: Connected live to an online radio broadcast meant to smear Chun Yuqiao, reporter Bianbian feigns forgetfulness and roasts the gossip-hungry host on air instead.

scenes.title: Radio Fallout and Security Check
scenes.summary: The commentators scramble after Bianbian's on-air ambush while Chun Yuqiao passes a security check on his way to a private meeting with Xin Huimei.
scenes.location: studio hallway and private club entrance

scenes.title: Asking for the Truth of the Breakup
scenes.summary: At a quiet lounge, Xin Huimei tells Chun Yuqiao what she heard from Luo Lin and promises to apologise if she wronged him, while he guards his private past and declines a drink.

scenes.title: Visiting Professor Fang
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu visits Media College to apologise to Professor Fang for her delayed graduation and asks him to explain the opening line of his annotated classic over a pot of tea.
scenes.location: Professor Fang's study at Media College

scenes.title: Turning Rivals Into Friends
scenes.summary: Over tea, Professor Fang explains the dialectical meaning of 'Dao Ke Dao'—how black and white shift with perspective and how rivals can transform into allies.
scenes.location: Professor Fang's study at Media College

scenes.title: Lawyers Tied Up Over One Contract
scenes.summary: In Xingtian's office, Xingzi and Kaiwen complain that the rival agency's entire legal and management team is tied up negotiating Xin Huimei's contract instead of answering Unit One.

scenes.title: Malicious Rumours and Broadcast Dilemma
scenes.summary: When fabricated scandal photos of Xin Huimei spread online, Xingzi, Kaiwen, and PR chief Stella debate the fallout if her charity-fund talk-show episode airs as scheduled.

scenes.title: Frozen Contract and Crisis PR
scenes.summary: Hearing that the rival agency has frozen Xin Huimei's signing amid the scandal, Chun Yuqiao spots a crisis-PR opportunity and phones Xin Huimei to meet at their usual place.

scenes.title: A Freer Space for Your Music
scenes.summary: After hearing Xin Huimei sing purely for the love of music, Chun Yuqiao brushes aside the tabloids and invites her to build an independent artistic home at Xingtian.

scenes.title: Orange Juice and Trust
scenes.summary: Xin Huimei orders orange juice for Chun Yuqiao's sensitive stomach and realises he sees through her tough persona to the straightforward person underneath.

scenes.title: Xin Huimei Signs With Xingtian
scenes.summary: At Xingtian's press conference, Xin Huimei announces her signing, Stella confirms police have caught the photo fabricator, and Bu Xiaogu grasps Chun Yuqiao's dialectical masterstroke.
scenes.location: Xingtian press hall and administration desk

scenes.title: Kaiwen's Chance to Redeem Himself
scenes.summary: When the two blacklisted commentators quietly reach out to Xingtian on their own, Kaiwen tells Stella to rest while he greets them and calls out their overacted on-air feud.

scenes.title: Screenshots and House Rules
scenes.summary: Kaiwen reveals that Xingtian captured screenshots of the commentators' deleted fake-news article and warns them never to ambush the chief editor's office again.

scenes.title: Bianbian's Peace Offering
scenes.summary: Reporter Bianbian explains why he wants to reform and partner with mainstream Xingtian on a positive feature story, only for Kaiwen to assign PR director Stella as his contact.

scenes.title: Stella Marvels at Chun Yuqiao's Move
scenes.summary: Stella jokes to Kaiwen about changing careers after Chun Yuqiao's bold signing of Xin Huimei solves the crisis in one stroke.

scenes.title: Rivals Eye the Two-Month Review
scenes.summary: Stung by Chun Yuqiao's victory in signing Xin Huimei, rival executives pin their hopes on the upcoming two-month inspection report for DTS.

scenes.title: Bianbian Meets Stella
scenes.summary: After praising Chun Yuqiao's wild crisis-PR instincts to Kaiwen, PR chief Stella meets sheepish reporter Bianbian and reminds him who created her department's trouble in the first place.
